title: Ext-colimit local cohomology equals derived torsion
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $J\subseteq R$ a finitely generated ideal, $M$ an $R$-module and $q\in\mathbf N$. There is an $R$-linear isomorphism $\operatorname{colim}_{n\in\mathbf N}\operatorname{Ext}_R^q(R/J^n,M)\cong R^q\Gamma_J(M)$, with $\Gamma_J$ as in [def-sbc-ideal-power-torsion-functor]. The colimit on the left is Mathlib localCohomology, using quotient transition maps and projectively computed Ext.

proof.text: Choose the standard injective resolution E of M. Apply the natural projective-Ext/injective-Hom comparison and whisker it by the opposite diagram of quotient modules R/J^n. Evaluate the functor-category colimit at M using colimitObjIsoColimitCompEvaluation and apply HasColimit.isoOfNatIso. This identifies the original Ext colimit with the colimit of the cohomologies of the Hom complexes.
Apply nonempty_colimit_homology_iso to the filtered diagram of Hom complexes. This identifies that colimit of homologies with the homology of the colimit complex.

Use the explicit evaluation-at-one colimit isomorphism of complexes and map it through the homology functor. Compose with the inverse of InjectiveResolution.isoRightDerivedObj for the ideal-power torsion functor. This proves the asserted object isomorphism. All quotient maps and differentials are those of the original definitions.

theorem nonempty_localCohomology_iso_derived_torsion
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (J : Ideal R) (hJ : J.FG)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (q : ℕ) :
    Nonempty ((localCohomology J q).obj M ≅
      ((idealPowerTorsion J).rightDerived q).obj M)
